title: One side below `MIN_BOX_COVERAGE`, and both fall back
why: An empty-state preview whose only mark is a heading yields a box of a few percent of the canvas, and stretching that sliver across its partner turns one line of text into the entire comparison. The fallback depends on the *candidate's* coverage, which the reference's `sha256` does not pin — which is exactly why the discriminant is a recorded field rather than something re-derived at evaluation time.
